dialogues.jp: 今日は、全体的になんか疲れたな。
dialogues.en: I was completely exhausted from today.
dialogues.text: I was completely exhausted from today.

dialogues.jp:
う〜ん、と背伸びをしてベッドの上であぐらを
組む。
dialogues.en:
I yawned and stretch my back, sitting cross-legged on my
bed.
dialogues.text:
I yawned and stretch my back, sitting cross-legged on my
bed.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、今朝は変な起床をしちまったからなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Well, I didn't exactly wake up normally this morning..."
dialogues.text: "Well, I didn't exactly wake up normally this morning..."

dialogues.jp:
さくらのやつ、まさか毎朝、来たりしないだろ
うな？
dialogues.en:
That Sakura, don't tell me she's going to do this every
morning?
dialogues.text:
That Sakura, don't tell me she's going to do this every
morning?

dialogues.jp:
窓を施錠したいところだが、生憎と鍵が壊れて
しまっているのでそうもいかない。
dialogues.en:
It's practically hopeless to try and fix that window lock
now.
dialogues.text:
It's practically hopeless to try and fix that window lock
now.

dialogues.jp:
仕方ない……俺は長方形の紙に『悪霊退散』と
書くと窓に貼り付けた。
dialogues.en:
Nothing much else I can do. I grabbed a large piece of paper
and wrote "Evil Spirits Begone!", and leant it against the
window.
dialogues.text:
Nothing much else I can do. I grabbed a large piece of paper
and wrote "Evil Spirits Begone!", and leant it against the
window.

dialogues.jp: あいつが魔女ならこれで大丈夫だろう。
dialogues.en: She's a witch, so that should do the trick.
dialogues.text: She's a witch, so that should do the trick.

dialogues.jp: 俺は大きな｛あくび／欠伸｝をすると、布団の中に潜る。
dialogues.en: I let out another big yawn, then fall back onto my futon.
dialogues.text: I let out another big yawn, then fall back onto my futon.

dialogues.jp: 「一応、目覚ましをセットしておくか」
dialogues.en: "Oh right, I should set my alarm clock..."
dialogues.text: "Oh right, I should set my alarm clock..."

dialogues.jp:
拘束してある目覚ましに手を伸ばし、起床｛・・／予定｝
時刻をセットする。
dialogues.en:
I grab the tied-up alarm clock, and start setting the alarm
for it.
dialogues.text:
I grab the tied-up alarm clock, and start setting the alarm
for it.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、寝た。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I slept.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I slept.

dialogues.jp:
今日は朝からさくらの奇襲を食らってさんざん
だった。
dialogues.en: This morning, I was the victim of a surprise raid by Sakura.
dialogues.text: This morning, I was the victim of a surprise raid by Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
平穏な生活を守るため、俺は鍵のかからない窓
に「悪霊退散」と書いた即席のお札を貼った。
これでやつもうかつには近付けまい。
dialogues.en:
To protect my peaceful mornings, I put a "Evil Spirits
Begone!" poster to lean on the lockless window. She won't
get any closer now.
dialogues.text:
To protect my peaceful mornings, I put a "Evil Spirits
Begone!" poster to lean on the lockless window. She won't
get any closer now.
